name: Tawang Monastery (Galden Namgey Lhatse)
opening_hours: 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM daily · Morning prayer chanting at 7:00 AM
best_time: March to October (Torgya festival in January)
rules: Inner Line Permit (ILP) required for all domestic Indian tourists entering Arunachal Pradesh
Second largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in the world after Lhasa Potala Palace
visual_features: fortress-like whitewashed Tibetan monastery with golden roofs perched majestically at 10,000 feet on a mountain ridge overlooking snow peaks
description: Tawang Monastery is a Buddhist monastery located in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, India. It is the largest Buddhist monastery in the country. It is situated in the valley of the Tawang Chu, in close proximity to the Chinese and Bhutanese border.
